messages:
amelia: Heads-up — after the weekend incident we should lock down evidence retention and add a forensics checklist to the playbook. Quick sync?
sec-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 created: lateral-access-detection. Severity: 2.
cj: Agree. Biggest gap was timestamps for audit logs across regions, and S3 lifecycle policies deleting stuff after 30d.
dave: S3 buckets had default 30d lifecycle for "tmp-logs". We should set "evidence-archive" to 365d and make copies to our central forensic bucket.
amelia: Proposed short actions: 1) set central bucket lifecycle to 365, versioning + MFA delete; 2) add KMS key policy to prevent unilateral deletion; 3) add retention policy doc + checklist.
sophia: Product side: need to confirm data retention legal limits with @marta before we extend beyond current window.
marta: I'm looped. For internal logs we can go to 365, but customer PII retention rules vary. We'll need per-customer opt-ins documented.
cj: Implementation notes: add CloudTrail multi-region + CloudWatch Logs retention set to 1y. Also store encrypted snapshots in forensic bucket. Example policy snippet:
```json
{
 "bucket": "redwood-evidence-archive",
 "retention_days": 365,
 "kms_key": "alias/re3_evidence_kms",
 "versioning": true
}
```
dave: KMS note: current re3_evidence_kms is in us-west-2 and kms rotation isn't enabled. We should enable automatic rotation and restrict key admins to sec-keys role only.
amelia: Also we need to update the incident playbook: add a "collector" step that lists which logs to pull and how (kv cache, model instances, host journald). I'll draft an addendum.
sec-bot: Action items created: SEC-1234 (update S3 lifecycle), SEC-1235 (KMS key rotation + policy), SEC-1236 (playbook addendum), SEC-1237 (tabletop followup scheduled).
cj: Can we schedule a 60min tabletop for next Tue to walk through the collector flow and comms? Prefer after 10am PT.
sophia: Tue 11am PT works for me.
marta: I'll attend for legal coverage.
dave: I'll own SEC-1234 and SEC-1235. Amelia will own SEC-1236.
amelia: I'll put a PR up for playbook addendum and ping for review. Draft checklist will include:
- snapshot running instances (gcore dump if needed)
- copy model KV caches
- export CloudTrail events for time window ±2h
- preserve Kubernetes pod logs (kubectl cp)
- preserve /var/log/journal
- collect process list + lsof
cj: Add retention change to infra change calendar and flag as security-critical so we don't auto-apply without review.
amelia: Also need a note about audit-log enrichment: include requester service account and routing policy in logs for machine actions.
sophia: Can we add a short line to product-facing postmortem that explains we extended internal defensive retention; no customer data was affected.
amelia: Yes. I'll draft that and send to @marta for legal signoff before public comms.
sec-bot: SEC-1234 moved to In Progress by dave.
cj: small ask — for evidence retention policy let's add an exception flow for cases where legal asks to preserve beyond retention, add ticket template.
marta: I'll provide the template. Also confirm archived evidence access audit (who accessed what) — logbot should send weekly access reports to sec-audit.
logbot: Scheduled report: evidence-bucket-access, daily digest -> #eng-security (starting tomorrow).
dave: I'll enable bucket logging and make sure logs are writen to secure bucket.
amelia: Thanks all. Timeline: SEC-1234/5 done by EOD Fri, SEC-1236 PR by Thu, tabletop Tue 11am PT. Closing comments?
cj: thumbs up :thumbsup: \nsophia: LGTM
marta: Thanks.
